# OMP NInfer

> Durable local inference for coding agents: the qualified local inference appliance for
> Oh My Pi. Your coding session should survive the process. Oh My Pi (coding-agent client) →
> OMP NInfer (qualified appliance and release layer) → NInfer (inference engine) → Qwen3.8 27B
> (served model). Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Oh My Pi, Qwen, or
> NVIDIA.

Qualified on RTX 5090 · 4090 · 3090 — **v0.19.0** (published 2026-11-13, GitHub Latest), stock
**Oh My Pi 18.20.0**. The 0.x series supports only the latest published release and its exact
manifest and profiles.

## Lanes

The lane runtimes are builds of the `alphastorm/ninfer` fork of [`Neroued/ninfer`](https://github.com/Neroued/ninfer).

- **RTX 5090:** Docker Desktop/WSL2 container on Windows 11, loopback `127.0.0.1:18089`, runtime `v0.7.0-qwen38-5090-beta.8`.
  Clients: Windows (local), macOS over a manual SSH tunnel (preview), Linux under WSL2; two requests in flight, 131,072-token context, vision, tools, and JSON-schema output.
- **RTX 4090:** Native Windows 11 package on loopback `127.0.0.1:18082`, runtime `v0.8.0-qwen38-4090-beta.3` (bound to its GPU UUID; one native lane runs at a time).
  Local Windows client; one request at a time over a 131,072-token context, serving text, tools, and JSON-schema output (no vision).
- **RTX 3090:** Native Windows 11 package on loopback `127.0.0.1:18082`, runtime `v0.8.0-qwen38-3090-beta.4` (bound to its GPU UUID; one native lane runs at a time).
  Local Windows client; two requests in flight over one shared 131,072-token pool under a 350 W cap, serving text, tools, and JSON-schema output (no vision).

## Measured

- **RTX 5090:** 181.71 tok/s server-side decode; 56.67 s exact 130,048-token retrieval from a cold start.
- **RTX 4090:** 253.71 tok/s decode (measured with one request at a time); 83.45 s exact 130,048-token retrieval.
- **RTX 3090:** 227.19 tok/s decode (measured with one request at a time); 188.45 s exact 130,048-token retrieval.

Each lane is measured on its own gate, so the lanes are not a ranking; method and receipts are in
[current qualified results](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md#current-qualified-results).

## Invariants

- Runtime listeners bind loopback only, every request is bearer-authenticated, and an unreachable GPU fails the turn instead of answering from a cloud model.
- Oh My Pi's transcript is the source of truth, and replaying it is the fallback.
- Checkpoints are best effort and restore only on the same runtime, model, profile, and credentials.
- One hash-pinned Qwen3.8 27B artifact serves all three lanes ([models](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/FACTS.md#models)).

## Proof

Every documented install route (five routes, 31 command blocks) was run end to end on the current release with unmodified Oh My Pi
on three client platforms, including both native Windows package installs:
[acceptance receipt](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.19.0/releases/v0.19.0/acceptance/composed-external-installation.json). All results are owner-operated measurements.
